lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਨ ਮੇਰੀ ਚਿੰਤ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਨਿ ਲਾਹਿਆ ਧੋਖਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har dhan meree chi(n)t visaaree har dhan laahiaa dhokhaa ||
lines.translation: Through the wealth of the Lord, I have forgotten my anxiety; through the wealth of the Lord, my doubt has been dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਨ ਤੇ ਮੈ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ਹਾਥਿ ਚਰਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਥੋਕਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: har dhan te mai nav nidh paaee haath chario har thokaa ||3||
lines.translation: From the wealth of the Lord, I have obtained the nine treasures; the true essence of the Lord has come into my hands. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਾਵਹੁ ਖਰਚਹੁ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਲਤ ਪਲਤ ਕੈ ਸੰਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: khaavahu kharachahu tot na aavai halat palat kai sa(n)ge ||
lines.translation: No matter how much I eat and expend this wealth, it is not exhausted; here and hereafter, it remains with me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਦਿ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਦੀਆ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੰਗੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: laad khajaanaa gur naanak kau deeaa ihu man har ra(n)g ra(n)ge ||4||2||3||
lines.translation: Loading the treasure, Guru Nanak has given it, and this mind is imbued with the Lord's Love. ||4||2||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਨਾਸਹਿ ਪਿਤਰੀ ਹੋਇ ਉਧਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis simarat sabh kilavikh naasahi pitaree hoi udhaaro ||
lines.translation: Remembering Him, all sins are erased, and ones generations are saved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤੁਮੑ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਜਾਪਹੁ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: so har har tumh sad hee jaapahu jaa kaa a(n)t na paaro ||1||
lines.translation: So meditate continually on the Lord, Har, Har; He has no end or limitation. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਤਾ ਮਾਤਾ ਕੀ ਆਸੀਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: pootaa maataa kee aasees ||
lines.translation: O son, this is your mother's hope and prayer,

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਬਿਸਰਉ ਤੁਮੑ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਭਜਹੁ ਜਗਦੀਸ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: nimakh na bisarau tumh kau har har sadaa bhajahu jagadees ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: that you may never forget the Lord, Har, Har, even for an instant. May you ever vibrate upon the Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਮੑ ਕਉ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur tumh kau hoi daiaalaa sa(n)tasa(n)g teree preet ||
lines.translation: May the True Guru be kind to you, and may you love the Society of the Saints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਪੜੁ ਪਤਿ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਰਾਖੀ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਨੀਤਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kaapaR pat paramesar raakhee bhojan keeratan neet ||2||
lines.translation: May the preservation of your honor by the Transcendent Lord be your clothes, and may the singing of His Praises be your food. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਚਿਰੁ ਜੀਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਅਨਦ ਅਨੰਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit peevahu sadaa chir jeevahu har simarat anad ana(n)taa ||
lines.translation: So drink in forever the Ambrosial Nectar; may you live long, and may the meditative remembrance of the Lord give you infinite delight.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੰਗ ਤਮਾਸਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾ ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਚਿੰਤਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ra(n)g tamaasaa pooran aasaa kabahi na biaapai chi(n)taa ||3||
lines.translation: May joy and pleasure be yours; may your hopes be fulfilled, and may you never be troubled by worries. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਵਰੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰਾ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਵਉ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣਾ ਹੋਹੁ ਕਉਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhavar tumhaaraa ihu man hovau har charanaa hohu kaulaa ||
lines.translation: Let this mind of yours be the bumble bee, and let the Lord's feet be the lotus flower.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਉਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਪਟਾਇਓ ਜਿਉ ਬੂੰਦਹਿ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕੁ ਮਉਲਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak daas un sa(n)g lapataaio jiu boo(n)dahi chaatrik maulaa ||4||3||4||
lines.translation: Says servant Nanak, attach your mind to them, and blossom forth like the song-bird, upon finding the rain-drop. ||4||3||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਤਾ ਕਰੈ ਪਛਮ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ਪੂਰਬ ਹੀ ਲੈ ਜਾਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: mataa karai pachham kai taaee poorab hee lai jaat ||
lines.translation: He decides to go to the west, but the Lord leads him away to the east.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਨਹਾਰਾ ਆਪਨ ਹਾਥਿ ਮਤਾਤ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: khin mahi thaap uthaapanahaaraa aapan haath mataat ||1||
lines.translation: In an instant, He establishes and disestablishes; He holds all matters in His hands. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਆਨਪ ਕਾਹੂ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: siaanap kaahoo kaam na aat ||
lines.translation: Cleverness is of no use at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਅਨਰੂਪਿਓ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੀ ਉਹ ਬਾਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo anaroopio thaakur merai hoi rahee uh baat ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Whatever my Lord and Master deems to be right - that alone comes to pass. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਸੁ ਕਮਾਵਨ ਧਨ ਜੋਰਨ ਕੀ ਮਨਸਾ ਬੀਚੇ ਨਿਕਸੇ ਸਾਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: des kamaavan dhan joran kee manasaa beeche nikase saas ||
lines.translation: In his desire to acquire land and accumulate wealth, one's breath escapes him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਸਕਰ ਨੇਬ ਖਵਾਸ ਸਭ ਤਿਆਗੇ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਊਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਸ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: lasakar neb khavaas sabh tiaage jam pur ooth sidhaas ||2||
lines.translation: He must leave all his armies, assistants and servants; rising up, he departs to the City of Death. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਨਿ ਮਨਹਠ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਤਾ ਆਪਸ ਕਉ ਜਾਨਾਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: hoi ana(n)n manahath kee driRataa aapas kau jaanaat ||
lines.translation: Believing himself to be unique, he clings to his stubborn mind, and shows himself off.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਅਨਿੰਦੁ ਨਿੰਦੁ ਕਰਿ ਛੋਡਿਓ ਸੋਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਖਾਤ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jo ani(n)d ni(n)d kar chhodio soee phir phir khaat ||3||
lines.translation: That food, which the blameless people have condemned and discarded, he eats again and again. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਭਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਕਾਟੀ ਫਾਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahaj subhaai bhae kirapaalaa tis jan kee kaatee phaas ||
lines.translation: One, unto whom the Lord shows His natural mercy, has the noose of Death cut away from him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਗਿਰਸਤ ਉਦਾਸ ॥੪॥੪॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak gur pooraa bhetiaa paravaan girasat udaas ||4||4||5||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, one who meets the Perfect Guru, is celebrated as a householder as well as a renunciate. ||4||4||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam nidhaan jin jan japio tin ke ba(n)dhan kaate ||
lines.translation: Those humble beings who chant the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, have their bonds broken.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮਾਇਆ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਮਤਾ ਇਹ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਤੇ ਹਾਟੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kaam krodh maaiaa bikh mamataa ih biaadh te haate ||1||
lines.translation: Sexual desirer, anger, the poison of Maya and egotism - they are rid of these afflictions. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਗਾਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jas saadhasa(n)g mil gaaio ||
lines.translation: One who joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and chants the Praises of the Lord,

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਭਇਓ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਅਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaad bhaio man niramal sarab sukhaa sukh paaiau ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: has his mind purified, by Guru's Grace, and he obtains the joy of all joys. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਓ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮਾਨੈ ਐਸੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਮਾਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo kichh keeo soee bhal maanai aisee bhagat kamaanee ||
lines.translation: Whatever the Lord does, he sees that as good; such is the devotional service he performs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਭ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨੇ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨੀਸਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: mitr satr sabh ek samaane jog jugat neesaanee ||2||
lines.translation: He sees friends and enemies as all the same; this is the sign of the Way of Yoga. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਥਾਈ ਆਨ ਨ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: pooran poor rahio srab thaaee aan na katahoo(n) jaataa ||
lines.translation: The all-pervading Lord is fully filling all places; why should I go anywhere else?

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਵਿਓ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ghat ghat a(n)tar sarab nira(n)tar ra(n)g ravio ra(n)g raataa ||3||
lines.translation: He is permeating and pervading within each and every heart; I am immersed in His Love, dyed in the color of His Love. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੁਪਾਲਾ ਤਾ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhae kripaal daiaal gupaalaa taa nirabhai kai ghar aaiaa ||
lines.translation: When the Lord of the Universe becomes kind and compassionate, then one enters the home of the Fearless Lord.
